reason: I’ll follow the rocky world first, since bringing it through the remaining disk is a chapter goal.
expectation: I expect the world and its moon to encounter material in the disk, though I’m unsure what changes first.

alternatives.reason: The debris also directly relates to a goal, but I want to follow the world first.

effect: The rocky world survived the remaining stones, completing its goal; I’ll follow the material between the planets next.
reaction: The widened view tying the world back to its host star was satisfying.
reason: The debris and fast bodies address the remaining goal about matter between the planets.
expectation: I expect impacts to break up or redistribute some of the debris, though the outcome is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The exposed gas may show material leaving the disk, but I want to follow the debris first.

effect: The remnant belt survives as a mixture of rubble and fragments; I’ll now follow material leaving the disk.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the earlier icy-body remains included in the belt.
reason: The exposed gas seems a direct way to follow matter leaving the thinning disk.
expectation: I expect some gas to escape from the disk’s surface, though the mechanism is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The fine grains may also leave the disk, but I’ll follow the gas first.

effect: Radiation drives some disk gas into the surrounding nursery gas; I’ll follow the remaining fine grains.
reaction: The distinction between the disk dispersing and its matter remaining was clear.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay action and follows the remaining material above the disk.
expectation: I expect the fine grains to disperse or leave the disk, though their exact fate is uncertain.

effect: The exposed grains are driven outward by radiation; I’ll follow them into the surrounding gas.
reaction: The distinction between small grains and larger solids was useful.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay action and continues the path of material leaving the disk.
expectation: I expect the expelled grains to mix with the escaping gas, though their subsequent fate is uncertain.

effect: The grains and escaping gas returned disk material to the surroundings, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: The contrast between retained worlds and dispersed material made a clear ending.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the remnant belt was most worthwhile: it brought the earlier icy-body remains into the surviving debris between planets.

leastWorthwhile.text: Driving out the fine grains felt least engaging because it was the only gameplay action offered, although its distinction from larger solids was useful.

surprise.text: I was interested that stellar radiation could drive the selected small grains outward while larger solids did not automatically follow.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the final two actions were prescribed by the menu rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I might continue for the connected cosmic story, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the final sequence offered.
